page: Vultr voc-s-32c-256gb-5760s-amd is an Optimized Cloud Compute server powered by an x86_64 AMD EPYC processor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 16 physical cores with 2 threads per core, operating at a base speed of 2.0 GHz. The processor includes 32 KB of L1d cache, 0.5 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of L3 cache, alongside support for AVX, AES, and SHA_NI instruction sets. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per core, and includes 5760 GB of local NVMe SSD storage.

Benchmark evaluations indicate strong performance characteristics across compute and memory subsystems. The server achieves a stress-ng multi-core CPU score of 99,520.25 and a PassMark CPU score of 63,855.09, placing its processing capabilities in the top 25%. Memory bandwidth is highly competitive, with large-block read-only operations reaching 515.15 GB/sec and write operations reaching 253.87 GB/sec, both ranking in the top 10%. Database performance is highlighted by a Redis SET throughput of 70.76 million operations per second.

This instance offers high resource density, combining substantial memory capacity with a large local NVMe storage footprint. The 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and high-speed local storage make it a qualitatively cost-efficient choice for workloads requiring large datasets to reside close to the processor without incurring network storage latency. It is highly suited for memory-intensive databases, large-scale data processing, multi-threaded decompression tasks, and medium-scale language model inference.
